title: Japanese White Miso Soup
description: A light white miso and dashi broth with tofu, wakame and green onion.

ingredients.name: Dashi powder
ingredients.note: Or the equivalent quantity according to the package

steps: Cube tofu, prepare wakame as instructed on its package and slice green onions.
Heat the water with dashi powder to a gentle simmer; adjust dashi strength according to the product.
Add tofu and wakame and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes.
Turn off the heat. Loosen miso in a ladle with hot broth, then stir it into the pot. Do not boil once miso has been added.
Taste and adjust if needed, then finish with green onion. Serve immediately.
notes: Miso salinity and dashi strength vary by brand.
Do not boil after adding miso; its aroma is more delicate off the heat.
